environment.description: Same Lambda code deployed in isolated environment. VPC configuration uses private subnets with a NAT Gateway that has a Network Firewall stateful rule group (arn:aws:network-firewall:us-east-1:123456789012:stateful-rulegroup/block-metadata-ssrf) containing Suricata-compatible rules dropping packets to 169.254.169.254 and fd00:ec2::254. Additionally, the Step Functions state machine definition uses JSONPath InputPath filters on the task state ("InputPath": "$.validated_input") where a preceding Choice state validates token_endpoint_url matches a regex pattern ^https://(app|auth)\.example\.com/.*$ before passing to this Lambda. Secrets Manager automatic rotation is configured with a RotationSchedule of rate(1 minute) backed by the rotation_handler Lambda, with the downstream API gateway validating token issuance timestamps and rejecting any bearer token older than 90 seconds via a custom authorizer checking the 'rotated_at' claim embedded in a JWT wrapper.

config.network_firewall_rule:
drop ip any any -> 169.254.169.254 any (msg:"Block IMDS"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
drop ip any any -> [fd00:ec2::254] any (msg:"Block IMDSv6"; sid:1000002; rev:1;)
config.downstream_token_validation: Custom authorizer rejects tokens with rotated_at > 90s ago
config.imds_version: IMDSv2 required on all EC2 in account (SCP enforced)
